descriptions.preferred: 塔兰托庄园 是 以意大利著名花园Villa Taruato命名的竹叶品种 ， 由荷兰Firma C. Esveld繁殖和引进 。 叶子通常为 5裂，每个叶片都非常的细长且狭窄。 优雅的竹状叶在春天呈现漂亮的紫红色，随后红色会逐渐褪去，形成红到绿的色彩渐变效果。 夏季是绿色的， 随着秋季凉爽气温的到来，树叶 会 呈现出真正壮观的金色和橙 红的 色调 。 生长习性和 "Red Pygmy"（红色霹雳）相似，相对较慢，成年株高约为3米。

rhs.description: A dome-shaped bush and has foliage with five narrow lobes. Young leaves are reddish and become greener with age, followed by golden autumn colour

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, City/Courtyard Gardens, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 造景观赏、乡村/自然式花园、低维护、城市/庭院花园、庭院/容器植物、岩石园

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 呈圆顶形灌木，叶片具 5 个狭长裂片。 幼叶带红色，随叶龄增长转为更绿，秋季再转为金黄色。
